title: Unlike the floating Panel itself, it's possible to interact through the gap between the Panel and floating Application launcher and widgets
line: Clicking in the gap between a floating panel's popup and the panel (or the nearby screen edge) no longer clicks the window underneath.
explanation: With floating applets, PopupPlasmaWindow is placed a margin away from the panel and, when constrained, from the screen edges. That gap belongs to no surface, so KWin delivered clicks there to the window below, which also closed the popup. On Wayland the popup now owns a transparent child surface whose input region covers exactly those gaps (up to the floating margin) while the popup hides on deactivation; a press there closes the popup without reaching the window underneath, and pinned popups keep letting clicks through as before.

commits.message:
plasmaquick/popupplasmawindow: don't let clicks through popup gaps

Clicks in a floating popup's gaps reached the window below. On Wayland,
a transparent child window now covers gaps up to the floating margin and
closes an unpinned popup on press; larger gaps stay as they were.

BUG: 517132

media.caption: Master: Kickoff open (left), a click in the gap above the panel (red circle) closes it and reaches the mouse-reporting Konsole behind, which logs it (right).
Fixed: the same click closes Kickoff and Konsole logs nothing.
Master: a click in the gap between Kickoff and the left screen edge also reaches Konsole (new 1;29 line).
Fixed: the same click no longer reaches Konsole.
Master, Kickoff pinned: clicks in both gaps reach Konsole and Kickoff stays open.
Fixed, Kickoff pinned: unchanged, both clicks still reach Konsole and Kickoff stays open.

review.text: Using a transparent Wayland child surface owned by PopupPlasmaWindow in libplasma is a well-placed mechanism that covers both panel-side and screen-edge floating gaps while preserving click-through for pinned popups, as demonstrated in the screenshots. However, the child window's visibility lifecycle is incomplete: updateGapWindow() does not check q->isVisible() even though QEvent::Resize and UpdateRequest call updatePosition() while hidden, and PopupPlasmaWindow never hides m_gapWindow on QEvent::Hide (leaving the full-popup-sized raster window marked visible and its backing store allocated after closing). It also eagerly constructs PopupGapWindow for every popup on Wayland and does not clamp the panel-edge gap to the actual distance to the panel.
changes: Guard updateGapWindow() with q->isVisible() (hiding m_gapWindow when the popup is not visible) and hide m_gapWindow in PopupPlasmaWindow::event() on QEvent::Hide.
Create PopupGapWindow lazily only when gaps are non-null instead of unconditionally in PopupPlasmaWindow's constructor so non-floating panels and tooltips do not allocate it.

Clamp the panel-side gap to the actual distance between globalPosition and the panel's visible rect (as done for screen edges) so a constrained popup on a small screen cannot cover and intercept clicks on the panel itself.
